annotation.summary_en: European Parliament resolution on cultural diversity and authors' conditions in the European music streaming market. It calls for fairer revenue distribution, prominence of European works, algorithm transparency, labelling of AI-generated music, deepfake detection, and copyright reservation and training-data transparency for generative AI.
annotation.title_clean: Cultural diversity and the conditions for authors in the European music streaming market
annotation.title_en: Cultural diversity and the conditions for authors in the European music streaming market
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
key_provisions_or_claims: Calls for assessment of fairer streaming revenue allocation models and remuneration for authors and performers
Calls for a legal framework ensuring prominence and discoverability of European musical works, possibly quotas
Calls for legal provisions on transparency of recommendation algorithms and tackling streaming fraud
Calls for clear labelling of purely AI-generated music and deepfake detection tools
Authors may reserve AI training rights; generative AI providers must publish training data summaries
